                                   有限公司，為本公司控股股東之一樂普醫療的全資附屬公司

 “TAVR”                            transcatheter aortic valve replacement, a catheter-based technique
                                   to implant a new aortic valve in a minimally invasive procedure
                                   that does not involve open-chest surgery to correct severe aortic
                                   stenosis
「經導管主動脈瓣置換術」                   指   經導管主動脈瓣置換術，一種基於導管的技術，通過不涉及開胸手術
                                   的微創手術植入新的主動脈瓣，以矯正嚴重的主動脈瓣狹窄

 “TMVCRS”                          transapical mitral valve repair system (chordal), a catheter-based
                                   system with two configurations, one enabling artificial mitral chordae
                                   implantation and the other enabling edge-to-edge chordae repair
「TMVCRS」                       指   經心尖二尖瓣修復系統（腱索），一種基於導管且具備兩種裝置的系
                                   統，一種實現人工二尖瓣腱索植入，另一種實現緣對緣腱索修復

 “TMVR”                            transcatheter mitral valve repair, which provides a newer, minimally
                                   invasive option for treating the most common form of mitral valve
                                   leakage for people who cannot undergo open-heart surgery. It
                                   is implanted via a tri-axial transcatheter technique and involves
                                   suturing together the anterior and posterior mitral valve leaflets
「TMVR」                         指   經導管二尖瓣修復術，為無法接受心臟直視手術的人治療最常見的二
                                   尖瓣滲漏提供了一種更新、微創選擇。通過三軸經導管技術進行植
                                   入，包括縫合二尖瓣前後瓣葉

                                                   between the left and right ventricles of the heart, which may lead to
                                                   abnormal blood circulation and pulmonary hypertension and other
                                                   complications in severe cases
    「室間隔缺損」                                  指     室間隔缺損，心臟左右心室的隔膜的缺損或孔洞，嚴重者可能導致血

             Case: Launch of ScienCrown Transcatheter Aortic Valve
                             Replacement System
              案例：ScienCrown經導管植入式主動脈瓣膜系統首發上市

In April 2025, ScienTech Medical successfully held the first launch conference of the
ScienCrown Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement System themed “Short Valve
Innovation, Precise Deployment and Retrieval”. The innovative design and clinical
evidence of “the only self-expandable short valve with the advantages of balloon-
expandable valves in the TAVR field” were deeply explored, injecting new vitality into
the development of interventional heart valve treatment in China.
2025年4月，心泰醫療成功舉辦「短瓣心研，收放無界」ScienCrown經導管植入式主動脈
瓣膜系統首發上市會，深度探研「TAVR領域唯一一款具有球擴瓣優勢的自膨短瓣」創新設
計及臨床證據，為中國心臟瓣膜病介入治療發展注入新活力。

During the event, participating professors and experts conducted in-depth discussions
on ScienCrown’s full retrievability, clinical trial results and clinical performance. Through
sharing 6 typical cases, the application advantages and clinical value of this valve
in the treatment of complex aortic valve diseases were systematically presented. Its
solutions for complex and diverse scenarios such as severe calcification, horizontal
heart and multiple accesses have not only broken through the limitations of traditional
valves, but also provided safer and more personalized treatment options for patients
with “millimeter-level” precision and the “full life cycle” management concept, marking
that China’s valve interventional devices have entered a new era of precision and
intelligence.
活動期間，各位與會教授專家圍繞ScienCrown全可回收、臨床研究結果及臨床應用表現
等方面展開深度探討，通過6例典型病例分享，系統呈現了該款瓣膜在複雜主動脈瓣病變
治療中的應用優勢與臨床價值。其針對高鈣化、橫位心、多入路等複雜、多元場景的解決
方案，不僅突破了傳統瓣膜的局限，更以「毫米級」精準度和「全生命週期」管理理念，為
患者提供了更安全、更個性化的治療選擇，標誌着我國瓣膜介入器械邁入精準化、智能化
新時代。

   Case: Academic Empowerment • Guarding Heart Health – Promoting the Upgrade
    of Structural Heart Disease Diagnosis and Treatment through Clinical Seminars
           案例：學術賦能 • 守護心康 — 以臨床研討推動結構性心臟病診療升級

In January 2025, the Shanghai Heart Valve Disease Intervention Center Annual Meeting and
the 8th Summit Forum on Cardioembolic Stroke Prevention and Treatment were grandly held
in Shanghai. During the forum, the Company comprehensively demonstrated the excellent
adaptability and stable occlusion effect of MemoSorb® degradable occluder series in different
anatomical structures and clinical scenarios through various forms such as clinical cognition
sharing, follow-up data interpretation and surgical occlusion demonstration, fully verifying
the efficacy and safety of the products. Participants also conducted in-depth exchanges
and discussions on biodegradable occlusion technology in response to clinical needs, jointly
promoting technological progress and providing safer and better interventional treatment
plans for patients with structural heart diseases.
2025年1月，上海市心臟瓣膜病介入中心年會、第八屆心源性腦卒中防治高峰論壇在上海隆重
召開。論壇期間，公司通過臨床認知分享、隨訪數據解讀、手術封堵演示等多種形式，全方位
展示了MemoSorb ® 可降解系列封堵器在不同解剖結構與臨床場景下的優異適配性與穩定封堵效
果，充分驗證了產品的有效性與安全性。與會專家同步圍繞臨床需求，就可降解封堵技術開展
深入交流與研討，共同推動技術水平提升，為結構性心臟病患者提供更安全、更優質的介入治
療方案。

                          Case: Gathering Wisdom to Tackle Challenges • Guarding Children’s Hearts – Empowering
                           Precision Diagnosis and Treatment for Pediatric CHD Patients through Practical Sharing
                                     案例：聚智攻堅 • 守護童心 — 以實踐分享賦能先心患兒精準診療

                     In April 2025, the National Conference on Congenital Heart Disease Surgery was successfully
                     held in Nanjing. Leading domestic and international experts and scholars gathered to
                     conduct in-depth discussions on cutting-edge technologies in the surgical treatment of
                     congenital heart disease (CHD). At the conference, ScienTech Medical’s MemoSorb ®
                     biodegradable occluder became the focus with its innovative technology and remarkable
                     clinical advantages. Participating professors and experts shared in-depth the single-center
                     clinical application results of MemoSorb® biodegradable occluder, further verifying the safety
                     and effectiveness of the technology and providing important clinical references and practical
                     support for minimally invasive treatment of pediatric congenital heart disease.
                     2025年4月，全國先天性心臟病外科會議在南京圓滿舉辦。國內外頂尖專家學者齊聚一堂，圍
                     繞先天性心臟病外科治療的前沿技術展開深度探討。會議中，心泰醫療MemoSorb ® 生物可降解
                     封堵器憑藉其創新技術與顯著臨床優勢成為焦點。與會教授專家深度分享MemoSorb ® 可吸收封
                     堵器的單中心臨床應用成果，進一步驗證了該技術的安全性及有效性，為兒童先天性心臟病微
                     創治療提供重要臨床參考與實踐支撐。

II.   BASIS OF PREPARATION FOR THE                                  二、 財務報表的編製基礎

      X.     DISCLOSURE OF FAIR VALUE                                         十、 公允價值的披露

             Inputs used in the fair value measurement are divided into         公允價值計量所使用的輸入值劃分
             three levels:                                                      為三個層次：

             Level 1 inputs refer to quoted prices (unadjusted) in active       第一層次輸入值是在計量日能夠取
             markets for identical assets or liabilities available on the       得的相同資產或負債在活躍市場上
             measurement date.                                                  未經調整的報價。

             Level 2 inputs refer to inputs that are directly or indirectly     第二層次輸入值是除第一層次輸入
             observable for the asset or liability other than Level 1           值外相關資產或負債直接或間接可
             inputs.                                                            觀察的輸入值。

             Level 3 inputs refer to unobservable inputs of the relevant        第三層次輸入值是相關資產或負債
             assets or liabilities.                                             的不可觀察輸入值。

             The level of the measurement result of fair value shall            公允價值計量結果所屬的層次，由
             subject to the lowest level which the input that is of             對公允價值計量整體而言具有重要
             great significance to the entire measurement of fair value         意義的輸入值所屬的最低層次決定。
             belongs to.

             (1)   Fair value of assets and liabilities measured at            （一）以公允價值計量的資產和負債
                   fair value at the end of period                                的期末公允價值

                   As of 31 December 2025, there were no financial                於2025 年12 月31 日，概無以
                   assets or liabilities measured at fair value.                  公允價值計量的金融資產或負
                                                                                  債。
